threads.body: `set_request_content` is called from the SDK exception and stream-manager `finally` paths without a guard. If the SDK rejects an invalid/partial iterator item (for example, a message iterator yields an integer), `get_input_messages` raises while processing the snapshot and replaces the SDK's original exception; the same extraction failure can also turn a successful call into an instrumentation error. Keep telemetry extraction best-effort so ordinary extraction failures cannot escape.

+def set_request_content(
+    invocation: InferenceInvocation,
+    capture: IteratorCapture[dict[str, Any]] | None,

+    params = extract_params(**snapshot)
+    invocation.input_messages = get_input_messages(params.messages)
